# Energy Property: Higher limits & expanded appetite


## Celebrate National Petroleum Day with Higher Limits & an Expanded Appetite


****


- **NEW LIMITS:** $4M TIV for Energy Property accounts
- **NEW CLASSES:** Oil & gas production equipment and underground equipment
- Energy Property coverage protects fixed property & mobile equipment with scheduled, leased/rented, & unscheduled or miscellaneous equipment options available


****


---


****


August 27th is National Petroleum Day and what better way to celebrate than with[Energy Property](https://www.kinsaleins.com/products/specialty-casualty/energy-property/) coverage from Kinsale—now with **higher TIV limits and a broader appetite.**


##### **New Limits**


##### **New Classes**


##### $4M TIV


##### Oil & gas production equipment
& underground equipment


Our higher TIV offers greater flexibility alongside our new classes, which join a broad appetite that includes **workover** , **well servicing and drilling rigs** , **pumping units** , **pump jacks** ,[and more](https://www.kinsaleins.com/products/specialty-casualty/energy-property/#target-classes) .


Kinsale’s Energy Property offers specialized protection for ground-up fixed property (buildings, BPP, Stock, etc.) and mobile energy and oil- & gas-related equipment. Our coverage includes options for **scheduled** , **leased/rented** , and **unscheduled or miscellaneous equipment** , as well as a range of[available enhancements](https://www.kinsaleins.com/products/specialty-casualty/energy-property/) .


**Explore the Potential** for your Energy Property accounts with Kinsale this National Petroleum Day—and every day of the year.


[Learn more](https://www.kinsaleins.com/products/specialty-casualty/energy-property/) about our policy structure, full appetite, and other Energy products, including Commercial General Liability and Control of Well. Or get started with a quote right now!
